signals.intro: Posted live by our analysts in Telegram. Mirrored to your platform inbox the second they hit, parsed into structured entries, AI-scored for confidence, and ready to paste into your MT5 ticket.

0.name: Aurex
0.desc: Our highest-conviction stream. Only fires when 4+ rules align across timeframes.

1.name: Vektor
1.desc: Tight stops, fast targets. M5 / M15 setups for active traders during London + NY sessions.

2.name: Meridian
2.desc: Daily / 4H setups for traders who can't watch the screen all day. Hold for days, not minutes.

3.name: Halcyon
3.desc: One or two signals a day, max. Curated by senior analysts when the chart is screaming at us.

signals.disclaimer: Educational only. Every signal includes the analyst's reasoning. You decide whether to act and you size the trade yourself.
